name: Plugin Manager
author: Brett
description: Every console plugin in one place: info, health, enable / disable, logs, settings, its UI, install & uninstall, and its dependencies in detail (what it needs, who provides it, who needs it, what clashes). Five views (cards, table, detail, dependency graph, install from the catalog) in four completely different layouts (Studio, Mission control, Terminal, Catalog). The model is the framework's plugin inventory engine (plugin-inventory@1), shared with every AXF web app's Settings → Plugins tab and the Android Plugin Manager. Opened from the default context menu, the Plugins nav section or Settings → Plugins → Plugin Manager.

builtWith.rebuildOf: opus build of Oct 18 2026 (pending item plugin-manager)
